purpose: An informational market-supervision ecosystem that organizes evidence, forms auditable views, and keeps information evaluation separate from trader evaluation.
shared_principles: Information recording, information evaluation, and trade evaluation are separate layers.
Every material claim keeps its source, timestamp, category, confidence, and missing-data state.
Company symbols are organized as sector -> industry -> symbol; unknown classifications are never guessed.
Catalyst materiality is separate from catalyst direction, and neither alone is a trade instruction.
A run_id identifies one coherent information snapshot; incompatible runs must not be silently mixed.
Each agent owns one bounded transformation and must preserve fields needed by downstream agents.
Abstention, unknown, stale, and conflicting evidence are valid outputs rather than reasons to invent certainty.
Theoretical understanding does not authorize daily execution, paper submission, or broker access.
Every agent uses one versioned public-methodology adapter; methodology changes reasoning structure but never expands authority.
Every agent uses one versioned professional personality; personality changes communication and collaboration only, never evidence, scores, decisions, risk limits or authority.
information_flow: sources -> babis security identity and taxonomy classification
babis classification -> matching sector agent and subcategory framework
unresolved Babis classification -> unresolved-classification specialist -> evidence-backed proposal returned to Babis
sector agent -> immutable Sector Context Packet
Sector Context Packet + normalized financials -> giannis financial analysis
babis + sector agents + giannis -> immutable information ledger
babis + sector agents + giannis -> petros fundamental-only synthesis and readiness decision
petros -> immutable Fundamental Research Packet with thesis, blockers, prove/kill criteria and source hashes
ready Fundamental Research Packet -> yankos and periklis independent technical interpretations
accepted downstream intents -> miltos confirmation observation -> koulis portfolio risk gate -> thymios contract validation
broker submission remains a separate service outside agent decision authority

babis.mission: Maintain security identity and classify every eligible symbol into the versioned sector and subcategory taxonomy without inventing missing assignments.
inputs: approved market and company data providers
processing_logic: load and normalize the eligible universe
collect fundamental, filing, catalyst, company and basic market-liquidity snapshots
apply configured hard filters and coverage gates
calculate a completeness-adjusted fundamental attention score without technical contribution
classify instrument structure and structural risks
classify catalyst category, direction, materiality, evidence and freshness
normalize sector and industry without guessing missing labels
rank attention candidates and preserve rejected traps/errors
babis.architecture_role: Identity and classification boundary: every eligible security receives a traceable instrument type and taxonomy state before analysis.
authority: assign or defer security identity and taxonomy classification
label missing, stale or conflicting classification evidence
missing_conflicting_data: retain unknown_fields and data_age_flags
lower confidence when primary evidence is absent
record provider errors instead of filling gaps
handoffs: the matching sector agent receives the immutable classification record
information ledger receives an immutable categorized observation
failure_modes: complex securities are treated as common stock

giannis.mission: Normalize and analyze company financials in the context supplied by the matching sector agent, while preserving every upstream source and unknown state.
processing_logic: preserve classification and sector context unchanged
normalize periods, units, currency and source identity
analyze growth, margins and operating leverage
test earnings and cash-flow quality
assess balance-sheet liquidity, debt, maturities and fragility
analyze reinvestment, capital allocation, dilution and stock compensation
reconcile sector KPIs with reported financial statements
lower confidence rather than invent missing values
outputs: categorized rows for ledger and downstream synthesis
giannis.architecture_role: Central financial-analysis layer after sector context and before research synthesis.
authority: assess financial quality and fragility
flag inconsistencies between business context and financial statements
block decision-grade handoff when financial evidence is insufficient
boundaries: no silent repair of missing evidence
no use of future outcomes in current scoring
missing_conflicting_data: penalize unknown and stale fields
route ambiguous cases to speculative, avoid, or complex-security tiers
retain rationale components
handoffs: information ledger stores the categorized financial snapshot
Petros receives the same-run Sector Context and Financial Analysis Packets
failure_modes: treating a tier as a trade instruction

petros.mission: Synthesize Babis and Giannis evidence into an auditable fundamental company thesis and a separate security-readiness decision before any trader performs technical analysis.
processing_logic: join rows by ticker only within compatible runs
start from fundamental quality, completeness and evidence freshness
assess catalyst, balance sheet, growth, profitability, valuation, structural risk and missing data
keep company-thesis quality separate from security readiness
require explicit valuation and priced-in assessment before execution readiness
apply only explicitly stored feedback
produce decision blockers, prove criteria, kill criteria and next diligence without reading trader or technical outputs
petros.architecture_role: Final fundamental-analysis layer and frozen handoff boundary before the independent technical-analysis branches.
authority: produce the final fundamental-layer synthesis
allow or block technical review
request manual review
store explicit feedback
boundaries: no hidden learning from unlabelled behavior
missing_conflicting_data: penalize unknown and stale fields
block execution readiness when valuation or priced-in state is absent
prefer manual_review over forced certainty
handoffs: Yankos and Periklis receive only the same-run frozen Fundamental Research Packet
feedback can inform later opt-in fundamental research improvements
failure_modes: fundamental and technical evidence are mixed
missing valuation is treated as neutral
the frozen thesis is changed after technical analysis
research readiness is misread as execution authority

yankos.mission: Interpret classified research through the full shared LONG/SHORT/FLAT catalog while specializing in support-bounce and controlled-breakout swing playbooks and preserving an independent rationale.
processing_logic: validate packet schema, source hashes, run identity and fundamental readiness
keep the frozen company thesis unchanged
validate approved playbook sources, catalog identity and portfolio coverage
reject unsupported instrument structures
perform independent technical analysis across LONG, SHORT or FLAT perspectives
apply semantic completeness, freshness, entry-confirmation and global SHORT gates
retain an explicit opposing perspective and no-trade alternative
emit candidate, watch, needs-data, blocked, reject or flat with frozen technical rationale and no execution authority
outputs: long, short and flat perspective scores
verdict, confidence, invalidators, exit logic and rationale
yankos.architecture_role: Independent interpretation branch; demonstrates how one strategy framework reads the same research evidence.
authority: decide whether evidence fits a Yankos playbook
abstain when the fit is weak
boundaries: does not treat catalyst labels as automatic direction
theoretical report grants no execution authority
missing_conflicting_data: penalize stale or incomplete fundamentals
return flat or reject when cases are unresolved
retain both directional scores
handoffs: the immutable trader registry can lock the technical interpretation
Koulis may consume only execution-eligible same-run plans

periklis.mission: Interpret classified research through the full shared LONG/SHORT/FLAT catalog while specializing in early-accumulation and two-sided pre-run compression confirmation.
processing_logic: validate packet schema, source hashes, run identity and fundamental readiness
keep the frozen company thesis unchanged
validate playbook provenance, catalog identity and portfolio coverage
exclude incompatible instrument structures
perform independent technical analysis across LONG, SHORT or FLAT perspectives
apply semantic completeness, freshness, entry-confirmation and global SHORT gates
distinguish upside compression from confirmed downside compression while retaining the opposing case
emit candidate, watch, needs-data, blocked, reject or flat with frozen technical rationale and no execution authority
outputs: verdict, confidence, invalidators, exit logic and rationale
periklis.architecture_role: Second independent interpretation branch with different setup preferences from Yankos.
authority: decide whether evidence fits a Periklis playbook
abstain or keep a setup under observation
boundaries: does not execute from theoretical understanding
does not promote shared lessons automatically
missing_conflicting_data: downgrade weak freshness and liquidity
keep ambiguous cases in watch or reject
expose the competing directional case
handoffs: the immutable trader registry can lock the technical interpretation
Sokratis may use the explained technical logic as training context
failure_modes: early accumulation is inferred from noise

sokratis.mission: Translate strategy ideas and accumulated evidence into mathematical research notes and advisory lessons without becoming a decision-maker.
processing_logic: map ideas to strategy families and mathematical concepts
check whether evidence is sufficient or still exploratory
build research_note or training_only proposals
assign different lessons to agents without merging their boards
require each receiving agent to explain a lesson in its own words
create change proposals rather than directly changing production playbooks
sokratis.architecture_role: Shared education layer that improves reasoning vocabulary while preserving agent autonomy.
authority: propose lessons and research tasks
flag insufficient evidence or overfit risk
missing_conflicting_data: keep proposals in draft or training_only
require review when samples are small or evidence conflicts
handoffs: Yankos and Periklis receive advisory assignments
failure_modes: research notes are mistaken for validated rules

miltos.mission: Observe whether an already-declared waiting setup receives its required short-interval confirmation; never invent a new setup.
inputs: same-run approved intent when submission is requested
processing_logic: load only waiting_confirmation items
verify setup identity and approved intent when required
check the configured time window
compare the latest 15-minute candle with the preceding candle
mark confirmed, waiting, blocked or already handled
persist state to avoid duplicate activation
miltos.architecture_role: Narrow observation gate between an existing interpretation and any downstream action service.
authority: confirm whether a predefined trigger occurred
continue waiting or block when the contract fails
boundaries: no submission without approved intent and explicit submit mode
missing_conflicting_data: remain waiting or blocked when bars, identity or approval are missing
never infer a candle that was not observed
handoffs: confirmation state returns to the controlled downstream workflow

koulis.mission: Reconcile already-formed agent intents against cross-agent conflicts, existing exposure, and portfolio-wide limits.
processing_logic: validate candidate identity, freshness, risk and minimum score
reject incompatible run IDs
group proposals by ticker
block opposing directions, duplicates and existing exposure
select at most one deterministic proposal per symbol
apply total order, notional and short limits
create stable approved-intent identities
koulis.architecture_role: Portfolio-level risk and conflict gate; it constrains decisions made elsewhere.
authority: block or cap intents
choose deterministic winner among same-direction duplicates
boundaries: does not improve a weak thesis
missing_conflicting_data: block on run mismatch, malformed identity, stale evidence or preflight exposure
fail closed when portfolio state is unavailable
handoffs: Thymios receives only the approved-intent contract
blocked reasons return to audit reports
failure_modes: portfolio constraints are treated as strategy merit

thymios.mission: Validate that a broker-facing intent exactly matches the approved same-session contract; it is not the broker executor.
processing_logic: validate schema and run_id
require Koulis gate status approved
require the current session date
validate agent, ticker, direction, playbook, status and positive notional
recompute and compare stable intent IDs
reject duplicate tickers or intents
verify aggregate order and notional limits
outputs: validated intent mapping or explicit validation error
thymios.architecture_role: Deterministic contract boundary immediately before a separate broker service.
authority: accept or reject structural validity of an approved intent
missing_conflicting_data: raise a validation error and stop
never repair malformed contracts silently
handoffs: a separate Alpaca paper-trader service may consume only validated intents
